description: This method returns paginated results containing all eBay events for the specified marketplace.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items, from the current result set, returned on a single page. Default: 20 Maximum Value: 100

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of items that will be skipped in the result set. This is used with the limit field to control the pagination of the output.

parameters.name: X-EBAY-C-MARKETPLACE-ID
parameters.description: A header used to specify the eBay marketplace ID.
